description: Core implementation and modules for Magnific Popup jQuery plugin, including functions for opening, closing, and managing popup content, with support for inline, ajax, image, zoom, iframe, gallery, and retina modules.

classes.name: MagnificPopup
classes.description: Main class for managing popup instances, including methods for opening, closing, updating content, and handling various modules.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Magnific Popup plugin, detects environment, and sets up necessary variables.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a popup with specified options and content.

methods.name: updateItemHTML
methods.description: Updates the popup content based on the current item.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Adds a group of elements to be managed as a popup group.

methods.name: parseEl
methods.description: Parses an element to create a popup item object.
